stemMd: A workshop produces 240 parts in 6 hours at a constant normal rate. During overtime its rate is 25% higher. How many parts can it produce in 3 overtime hours?
explanationMd: The normal rate is 240/6=40 parts/hour. Overtime rate is 50, and three hours yield 150 parts. Apply the percentage to the rate before multiplying by time.

distractorRationale.b: This uses the normal rate without the increase.
distractorRationale.a: This uses the hours ratio without the hourly rate.
distractorRationale.d: This applies a 50% increase rather than 25%.
